caption: The drawing depicts three detailed views of a decorative metal object, possibly a drawer pull or escutcheon plate. The main components are rendered in shades of gold and brown, with subtle shadows adding depth. The largest detail, at the top center, shows an ornate plate with a symmetric design featuring floral motifs, curling leaves, and a central keyhole. Below, another view shows the same plate from a frontal perspective, again emphasizing the symmetrical arrangement of flowers and foliage, along with a rounded handle attached at the bottom center. To the right of this, there is a narrow side-view of the object showing the profile of the curved handle and the raised relief of the decoration. The drawing is on a plain beige background with a rectangular border, and it includes a small scale in inches at the lower left. The name "JANET RIZA" is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Drawer Pull
